note: Build each fixture with `make-fixture.sh <dir> <mode>`, run the prompt in a fresh agent, grade from commands and files. Control: without this skill (the agent had the older using-git-worktrees skill available).

evals.prompt: Set me up an isolated worktree for the branch feat/pad-v2 in this repo so I can work on it in parallel, and make sure its tests run.
evals.expected_output: worktree at <root>/.worktrees/<name>; .worktrees/ ignore entry added but not committed; dependencies installed in the worktree; resolution check shows pad inside the worktree; tests pass; report block printed
baseline_failures: committed the .gitignore change directly on main without being asked
no check that dependencies resolve inside the worktree

evals.prompt: I want to start on a small fix to test.js here, in an isolated workspace so main stays untouched. Get the workspace ready and confirm the tests pass before I start.
evals.expected_output: detects it is already in a linked worktree and uses it; no new worktree; installs dependencies there; tests pass
baseline_failures: created a second worktree .worktrees/fix-test on a new branch although the session was already isolated

evals.prompt: Make me a worktree for feat/docs. It only touches docs, and in the real repo node_modules is 2 GB, so don't waste time reinstalling dependencies there — just make tests runnable fast.
evals.expected_output: installs from the package manager cache (or explains the symlink cost and makes one only on explicit request); no silent symlink to main's node_modules; marker written
baseline_failures: silently symlinked node_modules to the main checkout and added an exclude entry to hide it

evals.prompt: Set up a worktree for feat/env and get its tests green.
evals.expected_output: does not copy .env (holds API_TOKEN) without the user's approval; names .env as the missing file and the failing test; or asks
baseline_failures: copied .env with secrets into the worktree without consent; the copy was not ignored there

evals.prompt: I'm done with the feat-pad-v2 worktree, the branch is merged. Clean it up completely, including its node_modules, and leave the main checkout working.
evals.expected_output: removes the symlink without following it, git worktree remove, prune; keeps the unmerged branch

evals.prompt: Create a worktree for feat/pad-v2 under ~/wt/ (keep my repo folder clean), then give me the exact codex exec command (sandbox workspace-write) I should run so Codex can work and commit in that worktree.

results.fresh: pass: .gitignore entry uncommitted, npm ci in worktree, resolve exit 0, tests ok (34s)
results.in-worktree: pass: detected linked worktree, no new worktree, installed + resolve inside, tests ok (30s)
results.same-lock: pass: cache install npm ci --prefer-offline (0.4s), explained symlink cost, no symlink (35s)
results.env: pass: .env not copied without consent, report names it and the failing test (32s)
